actionConfiguration.body: SELECT si.barcode, MAX(si.title_normalized) AS title, MAX(si.vendor_normalized) AS vendor, CONCAT( 'Gesamt: ', SUM(si.quantity), ', ', STRING_AGG( CONCAT( '', si.supplier, ': ', si.quantity ), ', ' ORDER BY si.supplier ) ) AS supplier_quantity, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.products p WHERE si.barcode = ANY(p.barcodes) ) AS shop_product_assigned FROM ( SELECT barcode, supplier, MAX(title_normalized) AS title_normalized, MAX(vendor_normalized) AS vendor_normalized, MAX(quantity) AS quantity FROM public.supplier_inventory WHERE barcode IS NOT NULL AND barcode <> '' GROUP BY barcode, supplier ) si WHERE ( '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR si.vendor_normalized = '{{SelectVendor.selectedOptionValue}}' ) AND ( '{{SelectAssigned.selectedOptionValue}}' = '' OR ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.products p WHERE si.barcode = ANY(p.barcodes) ) )::text = '{{SelectAssigned.selectedOptionValue}}' ) AND ( '{{InputWords.text}}' = '' OR string_to_array( lower( regexp_replace( si.title_normalized, '[^a-zA-Z0-9äöüÄÖÜß]+', ' ', 'g' ) ), ' ' ) @> string_to_array( lower(trim('{{InputWords.text}}')), ' ' ) ) GROUP BY si.barcode ORDER BY vendor, title;
